actual_tools: local Python DICOM JSON and CSV validation
execution.implementation: DICOM 2026c metadata-only WSI fixture validation, local export planning, and an observed Rosalind task-chooser invocation; all Slide Viewer operations remain rehearsed

observations: All twelve local DICOM metadata checks passed for one compact VL Whole Slide Microscopy JSON fixture.
Sixteen 512 by 512 RGB frames exactly cover the declared 2048 by 2048 total pixel matrix.
Patient, accession, pixel-data, bulk-data, path, and credential fields are absent; no DICOM object was written and no upload was prepared or submitted.
A genuine Rosalind launcher call returned ready=true and the exact task-chooser message; no scientific job was executed.
interpretation: The fixture is internally consistent for metadata teaching and local export planning but does not represent a valid or remotely accepted Part 10 object.
limitations: The metadata-only fixture omits pixel data, functional groups, optical paths, dimension organization, specimen modules, and file meta information.
No DICOMweb query, object read, import, export, upload preparation, submission, or Rosalind scientific job occurred.
The plan does not claim de-identification, rendering, or preservation of a clinical source object.

provenance.note: Public DICOM standard identifiers support a deterministic metadata-only fixture; every Slide Viewer operation, DICOM write, and network action remains unexecuted.

reproduction: Run python validate_case.py from the case directory and inspect outputs/rosalind-open-observation.json.
Inspect the twelve metadata checks and the null destination plus false write, prepare, and submit fields.
Treat any later DICOM creation or network action as a new execution with actual byte, hash, source-reference, and response evidence.

environment.data: public DICOM standard plus self-contained metadata fixture
